svg.text: Spin Compass hub, section through the centre (1 grid = 1 mm; drawn 18×)
Grey: 608 bearing. Dark red: the two caps, clamped to the inner ring. Bright red: tray and lid (spin with the outer ring).
brass insert in the bottom peg
outer ring spins with the disc
0.4 mm gap: the screw clamps the shoulders
